_comment: Single source of truth for the project archive. Synced from github.com/karun99 (API: /users/karun99/repos). tools/sync-content.py writes this into projects.html (static, crawler-visible cards + ItemList JSON-LD) and into assets/js/main.js (DEFAULT_PROJECTS). Only repos with a verified README and a real description are listed; stub repos with no README are deliberately omitted.

projects.title: S-AI — Multi-Agent Swarm Intelligence
projects.description: S-AI v5.1 is a TypeScript multi-agent swarm with an MCP server builder, skill creator, neural knowledge mapping and 20+ AI providers, published to npm as @saikarun/s-ai.

projects.title: Collabuild — Paper-to-Prototype Pipeline
projects.description: A multi-agent system that turns a research paper into a working prototype through an orchestrated pipeline of specialised research agents, so a PDF becomes runnable code.

projects.title: Celebrum — Local-First Artificial Brain
projects.description: A local-first artificial brain combining a persona model, a neuron/synapse memory graph, a truth engine and a guardrail engine, shipped as CLI, GUI and an MCP server.

projects.title: S-AI SoulBot — Consent-Gated Companion Harness
projects.description: A consent-gated AI companion harness with a Sentinel authorisation authority, a Jātaka behavioural guardrail registry, consent continuity and T0–T6 conformance tiers.

projects.title: Samvit — Local-First Personal AI
projects.description: Samvit (संवित्) is a local-first personal AI with one shared memory graph, five named profiles, a VISION accuracy marker and a ULTRON 14-check error-validation constraint. Python 3.9+, standard library only.

projects.title: neural-harness — Validation Harness Engine
projects.description: A standard-library-only validation engine that measures information-handling and neural-synthesis accuracy in data integration, and emits evidence-first research reports. JOSS-track research software.

projects.title: Glama-MCP — AI Gateway MCP Server
projects.description: A dependency-free MCP server exposing the Glama OpenAI-compatible AI gateway as four tools: list models, chat, stream and request status.

projects.title: S-AI Update — Synthetic Executive
projects.description: S-AI v6.1, a synthetic executive layer with security hardening, SSRF protection, sandboxed execution and TRL/MRL/IRL readiness.

projects.title: ArthAI — Agentic Commerce Gateway
projects.description: An agentic commerce gateway for MSMEs built for the Razorpay Buildathon: AI-driven fiat and crypto commerce with a six-layer financial governance and adaptive security layer.

projects.title: BuildBot — Research Paper to Working Code
projects.description: A student AI coding assistant that walks a research paper through SRS, checklist and implementation stages until it produces working, runnable code.

projects.title: HelixDB — Research & Learning Companion
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented research and learning companion that adapts explanation depth to each learner, so every subject can be studied in the approach that suits the student.

projects.title: Anvaya — Researcher-Controlled AI Memory
projects.description: Anvaya remembers the researcher, not just the research: a persistent, researcher-owned memory layer with personalised retrieval and evidence-backed RAG that cites its sources.

projects.title: ScholarSync — Research Data Portal
projects.description: A research data management portal with four-level role-based access control: researchers submit, department heads review, the research cell administers and the college gives final approval.

projects.title: AI Content Studio
projects.description: A React and Vite platform backed by ChromaDB for content creation, AI generation, knowledge management and model operations in one workspace.

projects.title: Perspective AI Engine
projects.description: A TypeScript and Express backend engine for building and deploying AI applications, with configurable content-generation agents and an admin dashboard.

projects.title: AI Studio — Generative Video Studio
projects.description: An AI-powered video creation and media production studio: a Next.js application for generating AI video and media content.

projects.title: Gemini AI Chatbot
projects.description: An open-source chatbot front-end built with Next.js App Router, the Vercel AI SDK for streaming chat, Google Gemini as the model provider and Vercel KV for storage.

projects.title: AppIdea — Privacy-First Product Workspace
projects.description: A browser-only product workspace that turns a raw idea into professional documents — Charter, PRD, TDD, roadmap and pitch deck — with AES-256 encrypted local storage and no backend.

projects.title: BlogBot / BlogWriter — AI Blog Engine
projects.description: Automated AI blog content generation shipped in two deployable forms: a native WordPress plugin and a cloud-deployable Node.js and Express web app.

projects.title: SWOTIFY — Security Intelligence Platform
projects.description: A full-stack security and intelligence analysis platform pairing a Python agent backend with a Vite web frontend.

projects.title: Autonomous Hackathon Agent
projects.description: A cross-platform agent that runs on desktop, mobile and web, continuously discovering hackathons, generating project ideas and building prototypes with zero-cost AI inference.

projects.title: DUET — Digital Twin Framework
projects.description: A digital twin framework with adaptive neural mirroring and parallel consciousness streams that uses the Gemini API to simulate a persona's cognitive structure, biases and worldview.

projects.title: Health Quest — Food-Literacy Game
projects.description: An ethics-first food education game for school students with a transparent Michelin-style Health Score and consent-first OpenStreetMap eatery lookup. Built with a student co-author.

projects.title: Teddy × TechLearn — M.Tech Learning Hub
projects.description: An AI-enhanced M.Tech CSE learning hub for JNTU Kakinada: the TechLearn static site plus Teddy, an AI study companion with chat, timed quizzes, notes and a persistent learner graph.

projects.title: TechLearn — M.Tech CSE Syllabus Hub
projects.description: A self-contained static learning web app built from the JNTU Kakinada M.Tech CSE syllabus: unit-wise theory pages, a repeated-question bank, interactive quizzes and progress tracking.

projects.title: CodeQuest — Coding Assessment Platform
projects.description: A LAN-deployable coding and debugging assessment system in PHP and MySQL with a three-tier model — aptitude, program writing, debugging — plus timed tests, automated scoring and anti-cheat controls.

projects.title: TutHub — Tutor & LMS Platform
projects.description: A tutor and learning management platform on React 19, Vite and Supabase with Drizzle ORM, covering course delivery, student progress tracking and session management.

projects.title: PromptPro Challenge Arena
projects.description: A prompt engineering challenge and competition platform with AI-powered evaluation, leaderboards and peer review loops, on Express, Supabase and Vercel KV.

projects.title: Plastic Waste Conservation Platform
projects.description: An education platform on plastic waste and conservation strategies with six real-world case studies and an OpenRouter AI tutor, built as a Class 9 project.
